admin.quizQuestion: What is the best first step when building an AI feature?
admin.quizOptionA: Define the user problem and how success will be measured
admin.quizExplanation: Start from the user’s needs, then choose the simplest approach that meets them.
admin.generatedContent: Begin with one specific user problem. Describe the input, the desired output, and a simple way to evaluate quality. Build a small prototype before expanding the scope. Keep source material separate from instructions, and review every generated result.
